abstract: Migration from Ionic Enterprise SDK plugins (Auth Connect, Identity Vault, Secure Storage) to @capgo/capacitor-social-login, @capgo/capacitor-native-biometric, and @capgo/capacitor-fast-sql or @capgo/capacitor-data-storage-sqlite, with a two-release data carry-over plan that keeps users logged in, OIDC mapping, biometric access control and lock policy, SQLCipher and localhost setup for encrypted storage, cleanup, verification, and failure fixes.
